deities.name: Oskar'enlil
deities.rationale: Their adaptable communal physiology balances instinctive body-weaving with explicit individual personhood and civic cooperation.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Thoryn-Rahek
deities.rationale: Soft bodies and temporary collective forms create a direct, if cautious, religious association with oozes and aberrant life.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Ishtanora
deities.rationale: Voluntary weaving for heavy labor is celebrated through village cooperation and peaceful shared work.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

note: These are broad cultural associations rather than compulsory worship; households, regions, and individuals may honor other deities.
